inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program: One child's file does not have signed health statements.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program (26 TAC §746.611(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Physician Information: Two children do not have medical facility or physician information on their admission forms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(10))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: There is sufficient evidence to support that staff did not demonstrate good judgment when arguing in front of a child in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - No Walking or Sleeping with Bottle or Cup: A child was observed to be sleeping with a bottle.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - No Walking or Sleeping with Bottle or Cup (26 TAC §746.2419(7))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: There is sufficient evidence to support that a caregiver did not use good judgment by discussing children's behaviors in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Opening/Closing: There is sufficient evidence to support that children, ages 18 months and older are combined for an hour during opening time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Opening/Closing (26 TAC §746.1615)

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Substitutes Called When Needed: The operation failed to call in substitute help to ensure compliance with regulations and to maintain the day-to-day smooth functioning of the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Substitutes Called When Needed (26 TAC §746.1003(6))

occurrences.finding: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk: The operation failed to share a copy of the incident reports with the children's parents within 48 hours
occurrences.violation_type_title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.701(5))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: The operation failed to report an incident that allegedly put a child at risk.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual: It was found that the operation is using different forms of prohibited punishment for discipline.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments -  Associated with Food, Naps, or Toilet Training: Caregivers were found to be withholding food and drink as a form of punishment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments -  Associated with Food, Naps, or Toilet Training (26 TAC §746.2805(2))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: The operation did not self-report the incident.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: The infant classroom was out of ratio. There were 5 children to 1 caregiver.    Corrected:  An additional caregiver stepped into the room to assist.     The first steps classroom was out of ratio. There were 7 children to 1 caregiver.    Corrected:  Two children were transferred to a different classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The operation did not have a current fire inspection. The last fire inspection was date /3/2023
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Care Requirements for Toddlers -Same Caregiver Regularly: The toddler classroom does not have the same caregiver on a consistent basis.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Care Requirements for Toddlers -Same Caregiver Regularly (26 TAC §746.2501(2))

occurrences.finding: Provide care consistent with child's habits, interests, strengths, special needs, including any special supervision needs: The operation does not follow the special request of the parents for the care of their children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Toddler Daily Report: The operation is not providing daily information to the parents.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Toddler Daily Report (26 TAC §746.2509)

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Steps- Prompt: The proper diaper changing steps are not being followed at the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Steps- Prompt (26 TAC §746.3501(1))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: The operations classrooms are out of ratio at times.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: The operations classrooms are out of ratio at times.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual: A caregiver disciplined children by use of corporal punishment.  A caregiver threatened to withhold active play, use of hand, and other objects to address discipline.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: The proper level of supervision was not maintained. The caregivers were unaware of how the child incurred the injury.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Parental Notification of Less Serious Injuries: The operation is not notifying parents of less serious injuries.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Notification of Less Serious Injuries (26 TAC §746.307(c))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: The caregiver did not demonstrate good judgement with the inappropriate joke of stating she bit a child in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Steps- Prompt: The proper diaper changing steps were not followed when a child's diaper was only changed once after being in care for over 8 hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Steps- Prompt (26 TAC §746.3501(1))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: During the review of children records 2 out of the10  records  evaluated was  found to be missing the food allergy emergency plans.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: During the review of children's records 3 out of the 10 records evaluated was  found to be missing  required information for the emergency contact person.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: During the walkthrough I obseved 1 caregiver caring for 12 children with a SAG of 2 years. The cargiver was over ratio by 1.     This was corrected when the director divided the children into two classrooms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children: Caregiver is completing janitorial duties in the bathrooms during naptime and while counted in ratio. Caregiver failing to intervene to stop and prevent inappropriate child to child touching.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For: During the walkthrough a caregiver stated they were caring for 12 children, I counted 14 children in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For (26 TAC §746.1203(2))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Drills: Although the operation conducted a fire drill for the month of September there was no documentation.     This was corrected when the director completed the documention.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: During revview of the centers operational policies, the policies were found to not have included promotion of physical activities.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: During review of Fire Safety the operation was found to not have a current fire inspection as required by minumum standards.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: During the walkthrough I observed a 6 month old asleep in a restrictive device for approximately 15 minutes.   This was corrected when the caregiver removed the child and placed the child  in the crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426)
